row.team_price_text: Standard Pro: from $158/month for 250 monthly active users (10 team members)
row.evidence: Inline Manual's pricing comparison lists only team-member counts and permissions under Organization (no SSO or SCIM), and its support portal says owners add and remove organization members by email in the Team tab.
row.notes: No SCIM or SAML SSO found by absence on the pricing page (both the customer and employee tabs), the security page, the developer resources page and the support-portal article index; there is no IdP catalogue app. Pricing is usage-based: customer onboarding Standard Pro starts at $158/month for 250 monthly active users (10 team members; Enterprise unlimited, contact sales); the employee-training tab lists $3.00 per active employee/month. The Public API (add-on) manages end-user profiles, tags and topics on a site, not Inline Manual team members; organization members (Owner, Writer, Reader) are managed manually.

plans.name: Standard Pro
plans.notes: Priced by end-user monthly active users, 10 team members. Public API (end-user profiles) is an add-on with up to 3 tokens.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited team members; up to 10 API tokens.

plans.name: Employee adoption (for employees tab)
plans.notes: Per active end-user employee of the customer's apps, not per Inline Manual author seat. Sits behind the 'for employees' tab; the text is in the page's static HTML.

limitations.text: No SCIM or SSO is documented; organization members are added by email under a role and removed with the trash/Remove button. Changing a role means removing and re-adding the member.

auth.notes: Site-level API tokens generated in Site settings > API Access, with an optional Write access flag.

rate_limits.text: Standard Pro: up to 3 API tokens, 10 requests per second; Enterprise: up to 10 tokens, 10 requests per second by default or custom.

user_api.notes: The Public API (add-on) covers end-user profiles tracked by the player (list, create, search, get, delete, tags), not management of Inline Manual organization members. No team-member API was found.
